sentences.en: Charcoal, a substance similar to coal, is produced from wood.
sentences.zh: 木炭是一种类似于煤的物质，是由木材制成的。

sentences.en: Coal, charcoal, coal coke and petroleum coke are used as fuels.
sentences.zh: 煤炭、木炭、焦炭和石油焦都用作燃料。

sentences.en: We used that whole bag of charcoal for our barbecue party.
sentences.zh: 我们烧烤派对用掉了整包木炭。

senses.zh: 木炭（过去式charcoaled，过去分词charcoaled，现在分词charcoaling，第三人称单数charcoals）；炭笔
